title: Laredo Police Free Green Parrot Trapped in Pickup Truck's Grill
excerpt: Laredo police officers freed a green parrot that had become trapped in the front grill of a pickup truck, according to Telemundo Laredo.
content:
Officers with the Laredo Police Department rescued a green parrot that had become trapped in the front grill of a pickup truck, according to Telemundo Laredo (KXNU).

The bird was found at the front of the vehicle, where it had apparently taken shelter. Personnel from the department's Property Division worked to free the animal safely.

No details were reported about the bird's condition after the rescue.

Sources: Telemundo Laredo (KXNU), Nov. 23, 2026.
